assessments.reasoning: The pinned SPDX repository object identifies the 3.29.0 Legal Team creator. The six controlled ranges cover that release marker and the ListedLicense identifier, name, deprecation flag, header and comment. The typed license node distinguishes the canonical identifier from the enclosing SPDX document ID. Its example independently resolves the semantic ambiguity of the abbreviated name within the same artifact.

challenge.method: Compared the structured identifier and filename with the prose spelling. Tested a 1.1-only notice with zero Invariant Sections and a Back-Cover Text, a 1.1-only notice establishing all three absences, an unavailable notice with no other authorization evidence, and an or-later grant with all three features absent.
challenge.results: A Back-Cover Text defeats the crosswalk even with zero Invariant Sections. A Front-Cover Text would independently defeat it, as would a designated Invariant Section. A 1.1-only grant with all three absent satisfies it. An unavailable notice leaves the predicates unverified. An or-later grant fails the edition-only condition even with all three absent. The spelling discrepancy affects transcription of the identifier, while the header and comment agree on its feature conditions.

limitations: The finding concerns revision 1 and SPDX License List 3.29.0 at 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48.
The comment spells the identifier GFDL-1.1-only-no-invariants. That suffix order conflicts with the ListedLicense spdxId and filename. The short name alone also omits both cover-text conditions.
SPDX supplies identifier semantics. Applying the identifier to a work requires evidence of its actual authorization.
reasoning: The ListedLicense spdxId is http://spdx.org/licenses/GFDL-1.1-no-invariants-only. Its final component matches GFDL-1.1-no-invariants-only.json. The name is GNU Free Documentation License v1.1 only - no invariants, and expandedlicensing_isDeprecatedLicenseId is false. The example header selects 1.1 only and separately excludes Invariant Sections, Front-Cover Texts and Back-Cover Texts. The explanatory comment confirms that all three must be absent.
